what_this_is: Open-source repositories on GitHub that do jobs people ask their AIs for, read by index-github-tools.mjs, which asks GitHub for each one's licence, description and activity and writes records/workshop-github-index-records.json: one Workshop tool row per repository, placed on placement:caller-sandbox, so find_tool_for_job finds it by its job and run_tool hands it back for the AI to clone and run on the person's own computer. Trillion never runs these and keeps no copy of their code; the person pays for the index, the code runs where they are. Per repository: `repo` (owner/name), `job` (what it does, as someone would ask for it), `install` and `run` (commands copied from the repository's own README, `readme_quote` is the line they were taken from, and {input} / {output} mark where the person's files go). A licence is never written here: it is read from GitHub each time the rows are made, and a repository whose licence GitHub does not report is read from its licence file (`licence_file`, with the SPDX id that file states in `licence_file_spdx`). Adding a repository is one row here, then running the script.

rows.job: Transcribe speech in an audio or video file to text on your own computer, fast and offline
Make captions or subtitles with word-level timings from a video or audio file, and tell speakers apart
Transcribe speech to text in Python with Whisper models, several times faster
rows.run: python -c "from faster_whisper import WhisperModel; m = WhisperModel('small', device='cpu', compute_type='int8'); print(' '.join(s.text for s in m.transcribe('{input}')[0]))"

rows.job: Remove the background from an image to make a cutout with a transparent background
Download a video or its audio from a web address such as YouTube, Instagram or TikTok
Convert, trim, compress or extract the sound from a video or audio file
install: brew install ffmpeg (macOS), or apt install ffmpeg (Linux), or the builds linked from ffmpeg.org
rows.readme_quote: ffmpeg is a command line toolbox to manipulate, convert and stream multimedia content.
rows.licence_file_says:
Most files in FFmpeg are under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1
or later (LGPL v2.1+).

rows.job: Separate vocals from music, or split a song into vocals, drums and bass
Turn text into natural speech on your own computer, offline
rows.readme_quote: python3 -m piper -m en_US-lessac-medium -f test.wav -- 'This is a test.'

rows.job: Turn a PDF, Word, PowerPoint or Excel file into Markdown text an AI can read
Read a document (PDF, Word, slides, scanned pages) into clean structured text, tables included
Find the cuts and scenes in a video and split it into clips
Upscale an image or photo to a higher resolution and restore its detail
install: download realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan for your system from the repository's releases

rows.job: Read the text in an image or a scan (OCR)
